title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27973v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. translated_title: MemOnce：一种面向大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.27973v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在长时程和持续交互场景中部署大语言模型（LLM）需要为未来的推理维护可复用的记忆状态，这对现有架构提出了挑战。标准Transformer会逐层累积token级别的KV缓存，随着上下文扩展，导致GPU显存线性增长和计算复杂度呈二次方增长。相比之下，线性时间架构虽然将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，但难以保留细粒度细节。我们提出了MemOnce，这是一种为大语言模型学习可扩展记忆状态的基础架构。MemOnce基于两项核心设计：记忆编码器-解码器：它仅缓存最终层隐藏状态中的一小部分作为紧凑的记忆表示，并动态地将其解码回注意力层的KV缓存；记忆稀疏注意力：对于每个持续输入，MemOnce自适应地检索相关的记忆表示，并通过稀疏……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MemOnce提出了一种可扩展的大语言模型记忆架构，通过记忆编码器-解码器仅缓存少量最终层隐藏状态并动态解码回KV缓存，结合记忆稀疏注意力自适应检索相关记忆，解决了标准Transformer KV缓存显存线性增长与线性架构丢失细粒度细节之间的矛盾。
en_tdlr: MemOnce is a scalable memory architecture for LLMs that caches a compact subset of final-layer hidden states via a memory encoder-decoder and uses memory sparse attention to adaptively retrieve relevant memories, resolving the trade-off between linear KV cache memory growth and the loss of fine-grained details.
